metadata.title: Retro Glamour Satin and Tulle Portrait

retrievalProfile.description: A high-glamour 1980s studio portrait featuring a subject in a voluminous tulle dress reclining on shimmering satin with theatrical framing.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dramatic studio composition where a central figure in a pink tulle gown reclines diagonally across deep navy satin ripples, framed by a gold rococo cartouche in the upper corner and anchored by wide-tracked block typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's diagonal pose contrasting with horizontal text
Soft pink tulle texture against hard-edged satin highlights
Ornate gold frame balancing the visual weight of the subject
Deep navy shadows providing a base for vibrant magenta and cyan accents
coreInvariants: High-sheen satin fabric with deep folds

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the central and lower-right quadrants, reclining diagonally from top-right to bottom-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: An ornate, scroll-work cartouche frame in the top-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the gold frame, down the subject's body along the diagonal tulle, to the bold text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark navy satin folds fill the corners, creating a sense of depth and luxury.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject and accents against a low-value, high-contrast dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a condensed, high-contrast serif with vertical stress
Secondary text uses wide-tracked, monospaced geometric sans-serif
Letters in the cartouche are tightly kerned and slightly italicized
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' and 'R' in the main name feature elongated, elegant swashes
The bottom title uses extreme letter spacing (tracking) for a cinematic feel
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, classical serif inside a frame paired with ultra-modern, wide-spaced sans-serif for a 'timeless meets 80s' look.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high-contrast vertical stress for the primary name.
Matches the geometric, heavy weight required for the bottom display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-angle studio photograph of a person in a voluminous pink tulle ballgown reclining on ripples of dark navy blue satin fabric. Use dramatic magenta rim lighting and deep shadows. Include a gold ornate rococo frame in the top left corner with a blank white center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a bold, condensed serif name inside the gold frame. At the bottom, add a single line of wide-tracked, cyan-colored geometric sans-serif text spanning the width of the image.

verificationChecks: Is the satin background high-gloss with deep navy shadows?
Is the tulle dress semi-transparent and layered?
Is the bottom text extremely wide-tracked?
Is the top-left text contained within an ornate gold frame?

mustRedesign: Must include the physical frame element
postGenerationChecks: Check for high-sheen highlights on the satin folds
Ensure the tulle looks airy and voluminous
Verify the cyan text is legible against the pink dress
Confirm the rococo frame has a 3D metallic gold appearance
recipe.reuseFormula: Reclining subject + Tulle/Satin contrast + Rococo Frame + Wide-tracked Sans-serif
